Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Entertainment and Leisure" as it appears in the following examples.
['Battle.net - Login Address Modified', 'ITUNES STORE FAMILY MEMBERSHIP 1 YEAR | 08 AUGUST 2018', 'Description Unit price Qty Amount Online Number, 3 month subscription Item# 18.00 GBP 1 18.00 GBP', 'We are pleased to notify you of the result of THE NATIONAL LOTTERY UNITED KINGDOM held on this week.', 'We happily announce to you the result of the BT-UK Lottery draws held on Saturday 9th of October 2010, Lotto 3/10 in Negate, United Kingdom.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
